note: Tracked 1919px desktop no-regression baseline for the Phone Slice 5 geometry guard (scripts/phone-layout-geometry-check.mjs). Measured on the slice-5 fixture plan rendered by the BASE (438a02e0) UI code AND by the slice head: zero label intersections and zero labels outside the pane at 1919px in both runs. The deck-label x 720-inch intersection this slice fixes exists only at phone widths (360-768px, where the phone label selector now runs); at desktop width the selector never runs and the full label set renders without colliding, so NO 1919px exception is granted — expectedIntersections and expectedOutsidePane are deliberately empty. Any 1919px intersection or outside-pane label is a NEW defect and fails the guard. Stable shape identifiers are the label texts themselves (the fixture plan is fixed data). If the fixture plan changes, re-measure at base and update this file in the same commit; a stale allowlist entry only ever warns, never silently passes a new defect.
